text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka murmured in a sleepy voice.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... I wanna go... Somewhere far 
away...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Vast grasslands rolling out like a green 
carpet, and the northern lands shimmering 
with auroras...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I've been watching a video 
compilation of scenic landscapes from 
around the world."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's full of scenery that makes my legs 
itch to run...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... Before I knew it, it was 
morning...

Perhaps she was so engrossed in it that 
she cut into her sleep, for Silence Suzuka 
looked a bit tired.
